description: Hyperlocal event discovery and social planning iOS app
notes: Auth migrated from phone/SMS to email-based OTP. Carpooling demoted to future idea. Railway deployed and working. Backend live at frnd-production.up.railway.app. Deployment startup fixed to use start.sh, Alembic DB URL normalization added, and startup DB checks/logging improved. Feed/backend enum coercion issues were cleaned up across the ORM layer. Saved events now sync across feed/detail/profile/plans, event share is wired up as text-only sharing, Plans tab now shows saved events plus a Going section plus My Groups/Public Groups, and create-event pricing was simplified to a single price field. Several UX/product questions remain open around group flows, create-plan requirements, hard-coded city copy, and event metadata breadth.

items.notes: Future idea — deferred with carpooling feature.

items.title: Group-scoped events
items.notes: group_id exists on Event model but no UI to create or view group-only events.

items.title: Attended events in Profile
items.notes: Backend GET /users/me/attended (past RSVPs with status=going) + ProfileViewModel.fetchAttendedEvents() wired up.

items.title: Settings screen
items.notes: Notifications toggle (requests permission), Location status, Privacy Policy sheet, Help link, Sign Out. Spotify removed.

items.title: Error/failure states
items.notes: Some actions now surface backend failures during creation flows, but most API errors are still swallowed and feed can still fall back silently.

items.title: Profile stats row removed
items.notes: Attended / saved / friends counts were removed from the profile header.

items.title: Event share action
items.notes: Share/send arrow now opens a system share sheet with text-only event details. No deep link or rich card yet.

items.title: Create Event field alignment review
items.notes: Event title inline validation is in place, but title/description/venue/address alignment still needs visual QA and possible spacing cleanup.

items.title: Public Groups UX parity
items.notes: Public Groups has a top-right plus menu, but join-via-code behavior needs validation against private group invite codes and there is no sorting/filtering UI for large public-group lists.

items.title: Hard-coded city/location copy cleanup
items.notes: Feed and fallback locations still include hard-coded Chicago / Hyde Park copy and coordinates in several places.

items.title: Event audience classification (University / External)
items.notes: Events do not currently expose a University vs External field in the model or UI.

items.title: Map handling for overlapping events
items.notes: Map currently renders one annotation per event. There is no clustering, stacking, or multi-event venue expansion when multiple events share a location.

items.title: Edit activities you created
items.notes: Activities can be created and joined, but there is no edit/update flow for the creator.

items.title: Tag activities with groups you administer
items.notes: Activity creation can already link to one of your groups, but there is no admin/owner-only restriction and no dedicated management UX around that linkage.

items.title: Verification code input limited to 6 digits
items.notes: OTP entry is digits-only and truncated to six characters in OnboardingView.

items.title: Auth — email OTP request/verify, JWT tokens

items.title: Feed ranking algorithm

items.notes: Updated to use email-based users. Primary test user: ecarmi@uchicago.edu

items.title: Dev OTP bypass (code 000000)
items.notes: iOS bypasses OTP locally in DEBUG builds. Backend also accepts 000000 in dev.

items.title: Database migrations (Alembic)
items.notes: alembic.ini + env.py (async) + full initial migration 0001_initial_schema.py. Railway Postgres URL normalization added so Alembic and runtime engine use compatible async URLs. Run: cd backend && alembic upgrade head

items.title: Rate limiting
items.notes: OTP/email verification endpoints are especially exposed. There is currently no limit on how many times a user can request an email code.

items.title: Background task queue
items.notes: No Celery/ARQ worker. Things like OTP cleanup, taste profile updates run inline or not at all.

items.title: Redis pub/sub for real-time chat
items.notes: WebSocket uses in-memory dict. Doesn't work across multiple API instances.

items.title: Event ingestion pipeline
items.notes: No real events beyond seed data. Needs Ticketmaster/Eventbrite/etc. integration or admin upload flow.

items.title: Full-text event search
items.notes: Current search is SQL LIKE. No Postgres tsvector or external search engine.

items.title: Taste profile
items.notes: Onboarding writes initial vibe-derived affinities, but swipe feedback does not update the profile over time and the Profile screen still falls back to a placeholder state in some cases.

items.title: Image upload / storage
items.notes: No upload endpoint. No S3/Cloudflare R2 integration.

items.title: Twilio SMS integration
items.notes: Code path exists but Twilio credentials not configured. OTP only prints to console.

items.title: Push notification delivery
items.notes: No APNs/Firebase integration on backend side, so notification permission alone does not produce actual pushes.

items.title: Admin panel / event moderation
items.notes: No way to manage events, users, or reported content without direct DB access.

items.title: Backend bug fixes
items.notes: Fixed: Group.memberships→Group.members, feed geo query, MissingGreenlet on taste_profile lazy load in auth/onboarding/groups/plans, Railway startup blocking on migrations, and enum/string mismatches via ORM enum coercion helpers/types.

items.title: N+1 query optimization
items.notes: Groups and plans load slowly due to per-member queries. Needs batch loading review.

items.title: Remove dev bypass before publish

items.title: Carpooling
items.notes: Model, router, and iOS UI already exist but deprioritized. Driver offers seats, passengers claim them, driver approval flow.

items.title: Real-time plan chat via WebSocket
items.notes: WebSocket endpoint exists on backend (in-memory). Needs Redis pub/sub for multi-instance support and iOS WebSocket client.

items.title: Group-scoped events
items.notes: group_id column exists on Event model. Needs create-event flow + group-filtered feed slice.

items.title: Friend discovery
items.notes: No in-app way to find/add friends. Could use contacts, QR codes, or search by name.
